paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar cooling bound from the R2 parameter (AGB/HB star ratio) in globular clusters using MESA simulations with Primakoff axion energy loss. Main (most conservative, semiconvection scheme) constraint: g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. The bound is mass-independent for axions light enough to be thermally produced in HB cores (m_a below a few keV); encoded as a flat line from 1e-8 eV (lower edge of paper's Fig. 1 range) to ~1e4 eV. A more aggressive value of 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 (predictive mixing, supported by asteroseismology) is quoted but not adopted as the final constraint. No DM density assumption (astrophysical bound, not a haloscope). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
